_comment: Change them per release here (or put a defaults.json in the frozen build's root folder, which wins).
A number becomes REG_DWORD. For hex or a string value use { "type": "dword" or "sz", "data": ... }.
overwrite false: a value already on the machine is kept (an upgrade keeps your tuning).
Add "overwrite": true to one value's object form to force it in a release.
The values below are the 2026-11-14 driver's own defaults (docs/STRIPS.md 10.5, PHASE2.md V9, engine.c).
They are the service-wide (legacy) values: a driver from gate G2 on applies them to the x8p only. A Twin X
reads Parameters\Units\<its key> and Parameters\Models\99 instead (built-in Mode 0 = observe); Setup
never writes those, and never binds a Twin X (docs/spec-twinx.md 6.9.1).
